name: Permit type
description: Kinds of permission a government grants. Deliberately generic and mechanism-based: the same permission is a building permit, planning permission, a permis de construire or a Baugenehmigung depending on the country, and a code list of national names would not travel.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Building
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to construct or modify a structure.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Planning
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission for a change in land use or development, distinct from construction consent.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Occupancy
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to occupy or use a completed structure.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Trade or professional licence
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission for an individual to practise a regulated trade.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Event
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to hold a public event or gathering.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Signage
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to erect signage or advertising.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Alcohol
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to sell or serve alcohol.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Environmental
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission for a regulated environmental activity: discharge, extraction, tree works.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Excavation or right of way
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to excavate or occupy the public right of way.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Transport
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission relating to vehicles, haulage or public transport operation.
